clock.play.what: Sets the clock playing: real time passing moves the life on.

clock.pause.what: Pauses the clock: real time passing moves the life on no more.

clock.counted.what: Counts the real time played, carries the part of a second, and pauses the clock at a commitment.

account.month.what: An account's month end: the interest it pays, its fees in their periods, the overdraft's fee and interest.

account.open.what: Opens an account at a bank on its terms, with its first deposit, its first month scheduled.

account.pay.what: Pays from an account: within the balance or the overdraft, with the bank's fees; refused with the returned-payment fee past them.

account.returned.what: Leaves the player a notice of a payment refused for want of funds.
account.returned.awaits: layer 5: the money screen tells the player a payment was turned down

card.due.what: A statement's due date: interest from here where unpaid in full; the late fee and the penalty rate where the minimum is short.

card.missed.what: Leaves the player a notice of a missed minimum.
card.missed.awaits: layer 5: the money screen tells the player a missed payment

card.open.what: Opens a card on its bank's terms: its limit, its issue fees, its first statement scheduled.

card.pay.what: Pays toward a card: what's past due first, then the last statement; a mark lifts where the record lifts it once paid.

card.report.what: Marks the credit record where a minimum is still short as long after its due date as the country's bureaus wait.

card.spend.what: Puts spending or a cash advance on a card, with the bank's fees for them.

card.stated.what: Leaves the player a notice of a card's statement.
card.stated.awaits: layer 5: the money screen tells the player each statement

card.statement.what: Cuts a card's monthly statement: interest, the fees that come due, tax, the over-limit fee, its minimum and its due date.

means.first-morning.what: Opens the first morning's accounts at a bank and pays the family's means into them.

tax.owed.what: Leaves the player a notice of a year's tax owed that the account couldn't pay.
tax.owed.awaits: layer 5: the money screen tells the player the tax owed

tax.reckon.what: Reckons a tax year where the person lives at its end: the year's income taxed at the resident's scale, less what that country withheld and what was withheld abroad (up to the tax), plus a self-employed worker's contributions and the VAT collected; the balance's due date scheduled.

tax.settle.what: Pays a year's balance on the return's due date from the account the year's last pay went into, or refunds it there; owed, and the player told, where the account can't pay it.

attributes.choose.what: Sets where each of a role's attributes starts, 0 to 100, when the life is made: every one at a level, or each its own.

script.write.what: Writes a script's first draft: each part a reader grades scored from the attributes that write it, the days given and the writer's spread; the attributes used rise.

script.revise.what: Revises a draft toward what the writer can do, on the parts the last read's notes name or the writer's own read thinks weakest; the attributes used rise.

script.read.what: Has a reader grade a draft by its own criteria (the Black List, PAGE), with an overall score and notes naming its three weakest parts.

script.summarise.what: Writes one of a script's ten documents, scored from Synopsis and Writing and the days given against the days needed; the best of the pitch's five goes with the writer's pitch to the financiers of the production that makes the script (producing.apply, producing.raise); the attributes used rise.

network.meet.what: Spends days among the trade: each day may make a contact, as likely as Networking, Speaking and Social Perceptiveness make it, each contact a door open to the market a production raises its money from (producing.raise); the attributes used rise.

directing.prep.what: Preps a production the life directs, once financed: its form (a feature, or each of a series' episodes), country, budget, shooting days and running time the production's, on its agreement's terms (the DGA's in the US: budget level, prep, shooting and cut days, the minimum fee), prep's share of the fee paid from the production's budget; plans its story, performances and images from Vision, Script Sense, Working With Actors and Visual Craft; teaches them over the prep days.

directing.shoot.what: Brings the plan to the screen as far as the schedule against the days this director needs (Leadership) and the set (Leadership, Communication) carry it; teaches Working With Actors, Visual Craft, Leadership and Communication over the shooting days.

directing.cut.what: Cuts the film from Editing in the Director's Cut its agreement guarantees against the days the footage needs, and sets the direction's result as its four parts' mean, one quarter of what the production comes out as (producing.release); the cut's share of the fee paid from the budget; teaches Editing.

directing.submit.what: Sends a finished feature to Sundance, Cannes, the Berlinale or TIFF, once each, chosen at the festival's own selection rate as what the production came out as (the four roles' blend) scales it; a choice counts toward how financiers take the life's next production (producing.apply, producing.raise), as a release in cinemas does.

acting.perform.what: Plays a part cast, once its production is financed: its quality from every component the part asks, one quarter of what the production comes out as where the life acts (producing.release); its pay at the agreement's minimum on the day the work starts, from the production's budget, taxed; read by the unions' routes and the permits' days and distinction.

acting.cast.what: Writes a part in a production the life acts in, and casts the life in it: under one of the agreements of the country the production is made in, in its format's medium, its budget the production's; written for men, women, either or a non-binary performer (the life plays its sex's or either's, a they/them life any), an age range, an ethnicity or none, a language. Read by acting.perform, which plays only a part cast, and by permits.apply, which applies for the part's engagement.

producing.option.what: Options material that isn't the life's for a production: a film, a series or a play, made in the country named (the life's home where none is: its currency, its option's zone and every later stage's terms), with the roles the life holds on it (not the writer's; the rest hired at the game's standard), its option paid to the rights holder; every later stage reads it.

producing.develop.what: Develops the life's own script into a production: a film, a series or a play, made in the country named (the life's home where none is), with the roles the life holds on it (the writer among them; the rest hired at the game's standard); its material is the script as last graded, its rights the life's (no option), its writers' agreement the market's, and its genre the script's. Every later stage reads it: the financing's package (the writer's pitch beside the producer's), the writer's pay at the shoot, the four roles' blend at the release.

producing.renew.what: Renews a running option for another 18 months from when it would lapse, at another 10% of minimum.

producing.plan.what: Budgets and schedules a project: its budget, the shooting days its script needs and the days the plan schedules, the producer's fee and the UK's tax credit.

producing.apply.what: Applies a planned film to its market's fund once (the BFI in the UK): a yes at its rate as the package (the material and the producer's pitch, the writer's beside it for the life's own script) sells it adds an award of its share of the budget.

producing.raise.what: Days raising the rest of a project's money from the market: broadcasters, pre-sales and equity closed one at a time until it is financed, each day's chance as the package sells it and the doors open to the market (contacts, a family in the business) widen it; every role's work waits on it.

producing.shoot.what: Shoots a financed project: the days it takes, what the days past the schedule cost, the producer's fee left after the overrun (paid from the budget where the life produces), the producing's result, and the life's script paid for at its agreement's minimum on that first day of photography.

producing.release.what: Releases a film shot, every role the life holds done: what it comes out as (the four roles' results, a quarter each, a role not held at the hired standard), whether it reaches cinemas and whether it earns back twice its budget.

identity.make.what: Makes the one person the life is, whose fields every engine reads (the birth date the playing age, the pronouns and Billed As the parts it may play, the languages, the citizenship, the family the doors it opens).

unions.join.what: Joins a union or guild (SAG-AFTRA, Equity UK, ACTRA, Canadian Actors' Equity, Actors' Equity Association, the WGA West, the DGA) by its own route read from the life's own productions (parts played, its scripts produced and credited, films directed): a card in the name the person goes by, at a standing (Full, the WGA's Associate, ACTRA's Apprentice), with its initiation fee and yearly dues recorded; refused where the life doesn't meet the route.

genres.choose.what: Sets the genres the person loves (at least one, each once, any number), the only genres script.write writes in and producing.option options material in; the film's genre then moves its earnings (producing.release, by the BFI's gross per release of its group).

permits.apply.what: Applies for the work permit an engagement abroad needs, in any role: an actor's part cast, a director's film prepped, a producer's project planned, in the engagement's own country and for its days; by the engager or the worker as the research says; refused where the engagement is done, no permit is needed, the route doesn't cover the role (the player told by permits.unkept), or who applies, the processing time or the term isn't known.

permits.renew.what: Renews a permit in force in the role it was granted for, where the research says it renews.

permits.decision.what: Decides an application at its processing time; read by permitted(), which acting.perform, directing.shoot, directing.cut and producing.shoot ask before the work abroad.

youth.authorise.what: Grants what the law of a country requires before a minor's engagement there in a kind of work, once: the child performer's permit or licence (layer 3's, or the seat region's own) below the age it is needed under, and the guardian's signature, a court's or an authority's approval of the contract below majority and the age the minor contracts alone; refused where the law bars the work at the person's age or nothing is required. Read by engagement(), which acting.perform, directing.prep and producing.shoot (the producer's work and the script it buys) ask before the work.

youth.release.what: Pays a minor's pay set aside (the Coogan trust's, the Caisse des dépôts' pécule) back from the world's youth:<CC> account into the person's account on the day they come of age in the work's country. Consumer: the account's balance, read by money.accounts' monthly standing (src/money/accounts/accounts.ts:157, where tax.settle is anchored) — the anchor belongs there, in a file this part doesn't own.
